title: Casshern R Manga Listed as Ending With 3rd Volume
content:
Retailers are listing the third compiled book volume of Satoshi Shiki 's Casshern R manga — the adaptation of Tatsunoko Production 's Shinzō Ningen Casshan original television anime — as the final volume. The volume will ship on December 18.

The manga's story centers on Tetsuya Azuma, who transforms into Casshern to fight mankind's enemy Andro and his army.

The manga first launched in Monthly Champion RED in September 2023. Chabo Higurashi is writing the manga's script. Satoshi announced in November 2023 the manga's move from Monthly Champion RED to Akita Shoten 's Manga Cross website. The manga restarted its serialization on the website from the fourth chapter in April 2025.

Tatsunoko Production 's Shinzō Ningen Casshan original anime first aired in Japan in 1973. The anime's Casshan: Robot Hunter animated video remake released in Japan in 1993, and Kazuaki Kiriya 's live-action movie remake released in 2004. Streamline Pictures and ADV Films both released Casshan: Robot Hunter in North America, and Go Fish Pictures released the Casshern live-action movie remake.

The anime's latest remake titled Casshern Sins aired in Japan in 2008. Funimation streamed the anime with English subtitles, and also released it on Blu-ray Disc and DVD in North America.

Shiki ended his Akuma Kōjo ( The Devil Princess ) manga, the adaptation of Biyori Harunohi 's original story, in May 2024. The manga launched in Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Sirius magazine in May 2022. Kodansha published the manga's third and final compiled book volume in August 2024.

Shiki ( XBlade , XBlade Cross , Daphne in the Brilliant Blue ) ended the Attack on Titan: Before the Fall manga in March 2019.

Seven Seas Entertainment is releasing Shiki's The Legend of Dororo and Hyakkimaru ( Dororo to Hyakkimaru -den ) remake manga of Osamu Tezuka 's Dororo manga in English. Shiki launched the manga in Monthly Champion RED magazine in October 2018.

title: Crunchyroll’s Highly Anticipated Ghost of Tsushima Anime Gets Bad News
content:
Earlier this year, at a press conference held by Crunchyroll , it was announced that Sucker Punch’s Ghost of Tsushima video game would receive a new anime adaptation titled Ghost of Tsushima: Legends . It was exciting news, and fans were thrilled to see another video game franchise receive an expanded vision. Among the many details announced, it was also revealed that the anime was aiming for a 2027 release window. However, new information has just been unveiled at New York Comic Con, pushing back the release date.

To be specific, the upcoming Ghost of Tsushima anime adaptation is now aiming for a 2028 release window. Additionally, new cast members for the anime have been announced, including Mayumi Saco and Shinya Fukumatsu, although their roles have yet to be revealed. That said, Saco is known for playing Tomoe in the game, while Shinya is known for his many roles in the anime industry, including Bomb in One-Punch Man . Although the anime has been delayed, the additional cast details hint that development is moving forward rather than the project being backlogged or cancelled.

Crunchyroll’s Ghost of Tsushima Anime Adaptation Is Aiming Big Despite the Delay

The details revealed for the anime so far have only reinforced that the project is aiming for high quality. This stems from the involvement of anime studio Kamikaze Douga, known for creating Star Wars: Visions’ “The Duel” and Batman Ninja , with Takanobu Mizuno, the director of the former, also returning for Ghost of Tsushima ‘s upcoming anime adaptation. This already gives the anime the potential to stand out, while the additional information hints that voice actors like Saco could be returning to reprise their roles, with more details potentially being unveiled in the future. Meanwhile, the source material also hints at how this anime could evolve in different directions.

Specifically, the anime’s title is Ghost of Tsushima: Legends , based on the expansion featuring multiple interesting characters, each with their own legends and unique strengths. However, the anime project has also hinted at capturing Jin Sakai’s main storyline, as suggested by a statement revealed earlier. This makes the upcoming anime particularly intriguing, especially given the visual teaser released earlier this year. Specifically, it features three characters, clearly suggesting that the story won’t focus solely on a lone samurai taking on the Mongol Empire but will instead follow multiple characters, potentially with three leading protagonists.

Based on what has been revealed, these legends could include Jin Sakai, Yuna, and, given the latest voice actor addition, Tomoe, Sensei Ishikawa’s legendary star pupil who rebels against the empire in her own way. With multiple storylines, the series could weave together the legends of these three characters into an original story built on the game’s foundation. Ultimately, Ghost of Tsushima has the potential to stand out as a video game anime adaptation thanks to its narrative possibilities. While the latest delay is unfortunate, it could give the project more time to become refined and complete before it begins streaming on Crunchyroll in 2028.

title: WEBTOON to Launch New Marvel Comics App in November
content:
WEBTOON Entertainment announced on October 5 it is partnering with Marvel to launch a new Marvel Comics app on November 16, offering digital access to Marvel's library of current and classic comics.

Marvel has additionally announced that its Marvel Unlimited service, which launched in November 2007, will end service in December. The service will stop adding new content on December 7, and readers will no longer be able to read comics on the service on the same day. Members will still be able to browse their library until December 21, and the app will officially end service on December 28.

Readers will be able to export their existing Marvel Unlimited library and reading history to the Marvel Comics app. Active Marvel Unlimited subscriptions will be eligible for an automated, prorated refund. More information on the end of Marvel Unlimited can be found here .

The new Marvel Comics app will be available on mobile and on browser. WEBTOON Entertainment is developing the app, which will include comics from Marvel, Star Wars , and 20th Century Studios. It will support both traditional page-based comics and vertical-scroll formats.

WEBTOON stated the service will also "continue growing with more features and stories from across Disney's portfolio."

The service will allow readers to browse thousands of comics through a cover-based interface, receive personalized recommendations, and follow specific series, characters, and creators. A Pull List feature will notify users when new issues from followed titles become available, while an enhanced smart-panel mode will enlarge individual panels for easier reading on mobile devices.

The app will launch with two subscription tiers. The Base plan will cost US$9.99 per month or US$69.99 per year, with new issues becoming available three months after their print release. The Ultimate plan will cost US$12.49 per month or US$99.99 per year and will provide access to new issues one month after their print release, in addition to the full digital library.

Fans can pre-register for the service and receive a limited-time founding member price of US$59.99 for the first year of the Ultimate annual plan.

The app is debuting at New York Comic Con , which is running from October 8-11. Those interested can get an early look at the beta version of the app at the Marvel Comics app booth.

WEBTOON Entertainment had announced a global partnership with Disney in August 2025 to adapt and distribute around 100 comics from Disney, Marvel, 20th Century Studios, and Star Wars in WEBTOON 's mobile vertical-scroll format. A month later, The Walt Disney Company and WEBTOON Entertainment announced they had signed a non-binding term sheet to develop a new digital comics platform.

title: The Ghost of Bongcheon-Dong Horror Webtoon Gets Live-Action Film Adaptation
content:
Horang's horror webtoon The Ghost of Bongcheon-Dong is being adapted into a live-action film.

Lotte Entertainment announced on October 7 that Arin — a member of K-pop girl group OH MY GIRL — and Chan-young Yoon will star in the film. Production began on October 5.

Based on Horang's short horror webtoon of the same name, The Ghost of Bongcheon-Dong follows Su-yeon, a young woman who begins experiencing strange phenomena at an apartment complex in Bongcheon-dong, Seoul, built on land where shamans once performed rituals. She becomes possessed by a ghost and is drawn into a centuries-old curse surrounding the area.

Arin will play Su-yeon, while Yoon will portray Tae-oh, a young man who can see ghosts.

Horang originally published the webtoon in 2011 as part of the horror comic collection The Vault of Horror: A Collection of Nightmares . The story became one of Horang's best-known horror comics and was later remastered and included in Horang's Nightmare in 2020.

Lotte Entertainment has not yet announced a release date.

Fans can read the official English version of the remastered webtoon on WEBTOON .

title: Chiikawa Anime Film Drops to #4, Star Detective Precure! Film to #5 in Japan
content:
Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, dropped from #2 to #4 in its 11th weekend in Japan's box office from last Friday to Sunday. The film earned 178,447,600 yen (about US$1.12 million).

The film has sold a total of 11.76 million tickets, and earned a cumulative total of 17,169,165,400 yen (about US$108 million). The film is currently the biggest film in Japan this year, and now ranks 14th in Japan's all-time box office ranking.

Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu opened on July 24 and ranked at #1 for its opening weekend. The film earned 990 million yen (about US$6.05 million) on its opening day. The film sold 1,508,500 tickets and earned 2,240,333,500 yen (about US$13.70 million) in its first three days.

The film's 4DX screenings began on September 5. One-day-only cheering screenings for the film took place on September 11. Penlight screenings took place on September 23.

The film is based on the manga's arc posted on X (formerly Twitter ) from March to November 2023, nicknamed the "Siren Arc" or "Island Arc."

Nagano is credited for the original story and also wrote the film's script. Under Nagano 's supervision, Kei Oikawa ( Uma Musume Pretty Derby 3 seasons, Hinamatsuri , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO! , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax ) directed the film at Cygames Pictures . QTORY inc. managed the production, and TOHO is distributing the film.

Eiga Meitantei Precure! Fushigi na Niwa to Futari no Himitsu (Detective Precure! The Movie: The Mysterious Garden and the Secret of 2 People) — the film for Star Detective Precure! , the 23rd main anime entry in the Precure franchise — dropped from #3 to #5 in its third weekend. The film earned 117,562,850 yen (about US$742,100) from Friday to Sunday. The film has sold a total of 860,000 tickets and earned a cumulative total of 1,088,603,930 yen (about US$6.87 million).

The film opened in Japan on September 18. It sold 358,000 tickets to earn 446 million yen (about US$2.82 million) in its first three days. In its first six days until September 23, the film sold 606,000 tickets and earned 746 million yen (about US$4.71 million).

The cast members who voice the film's original characters are Akari Kitō as Karin, a 14-year-old girl who holds the key to the story; Nobunaga Shimazaki as Alan, a fairy who watches over Karin; and Kōki Uchiyama as Rain, a fairy who requests the Detective Precures' help.

Hanako Ueda ( You and Idol Precure♪ , Summer Time Rendering , My Hero Academia FINAL SEASON episode director) directed the film. Yoshimi Narita ( Eiga HappinessCharge PreCure! Ningyō no Kuni no Ballerina , Eiga Precure All Stars New Stage 3: Eien no Tomodachi , Eiga Tropical-Rouge! Precure: Yuki no Princess to Kiseki no Yubiwa! films) wrote the script, Erika Fukasawa ( Eiga Kimi to Idol Precure♪ Omatase! Kimi ni Todokeru Kirakkilive! ) and Misaki Umase ( You and Idol Precure♪ ) composed the music, and Emiko Miyamoto ( Eiga Precure All Stars F , Precure Super Stars! original character designer) designed the characters and was also the film's chief animation director.

Yūka Masui and Chihaya Yoshitake perform the film's ending theme song "FIRST PRISM." Ami Ishii performs the insert song "First Step."

Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie: Walpurgisnacht: Rising ( Gekijōban Mahō Shōjo Madoka Magica: Walpurgis no Kaiten ), the official sequel to the Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion film, rejoined the list at #7 in its sixth weekend. The film earned 135,516,600 yen (about US$855,400) from Friday to Sunday, and has earned a cumulative total of 2,342,576,920 yen (about US$14.78 million).

The film got IMAX screenings in Japan on August 28, the same day it opened in theaters. The film sold 535,000 tickets and and earned 939,647,100 yen (about US$5.95 million) in its first three days.

Yukihiro Miyamoto ( Puella Magi Madoka Magica , Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story , Arakawa Under the Bridge ) directed the film.

Shion Wakayama voices the new magical girl Shichōka and Tomoyo Kurosawa voices Selma Therese.

The anime film features a returning staff from the original anime series and films, including original creators Magica Quartet , chief director Akiyuki Simbo , scriptwriter Gen Urobuchi of Nitroplus , original character designer Ume Aoki , animation character designer Junichirō Taniguchi , composer Yuki Kajiura , alternate space designer Gekidan Inu Curry , and animation studio SHAFT .

NOTHING NEW and director Kōhei Kadowaki 's We Are Aliens ( Ware Ware wa Uchūjin ) anime film did not make the top 10 but surpassed 100 million yen in box office revenue as of October 2. It has sold 97,401 tickets and earned 156,708,200 yen (about US$990,200) as of October 4. The film opened in Japan on September 25.

Shingo Yamashita 's Cosmic Princess Kaguya! ( Chō Kaguya-hime! ) anime film dropped off the top 10 in its third week after returning to theaters on September 18 with a new MX4D, 4DX, SCREENX, ULTRA 4DX, and Dolby Atmos screening .

title: How I Became King by Eating Monsters Novels Get TV Anime by White Fox in 2027
content:
Anime studio WHITE FOX announced on Friday it is producing a television anime adaptation of Daken 's How I Became King by Eating Monsters ( Monster no Niku wo Kutteitara Ōi ni Tsuita Ken ) light novel series. The anime will debut in 2027.

Original novel illustrator Shiba and manga artist Karin Suzuragi both drew illustrations to celebrate the announcement.

Cross Infinite World is releasing the original light novel series in English, and it describes the story:

The first prince of the kingdom of Farune, Mars, is only twelve years old, yet he lives in fear of assassination. In order to avoid the deadly poison in nearly all of his meals, he slips out of the castle into the nearby monster-infested forest, where, battling monsters and his own hunger, he has to hunt for his meals in order to stave off starvation. Then, one night, as he's searching for his next bite of monster meat, a red-haired woman shouldering a greatsword appears before him and says to him, “You have promise. Become my apprentice.” How is he supposed to tell her that this must be some sort of mistake? But there's a secret that only she knows, and that he's stumbled upon: eating monsters makes you stronger! With her training and his newfound power, Mars will finally overcome all those pesky assassination attempts. However, that doesn't end things; no, it's only the beginning of a nationwide—even continent-spanning—series of wars and plots with him right in the middle!

Cross Infinite World released the sixth novel volume digitally on September 30.

Daken launched the original story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" website in January 2022, and the latest update was in January 2023. Micro Magazine 's GCN Bunko label started publishing the story in compiled volume format in September 2023 with illustrations by Shiba . The company will publish the seventh volume on October 20.

Karin Suzuragi ( Danganronpa 2: Chiaki Nanami's Goodbye Despair Quest , Isekai Cheat Magician ) launched a manga adaptation of the novel series in January 2024 in Hakusensha 's Young Animal Zero magazine. Hakusensha will publish the third compiled volume on October 29.

Daken 's Tsuihо̄ Sareta Shо̄nin wa Kin no Chikara de Sekai wo Sukū light novel series is also slated to get an upcoming television anime adaptation. Seven Seas Entertainment is releasing Daken 's The Suspects of Necromancy and The Wicked Princess and Her Twelve Eyes light novel series in English. Yen Press is releasing Daken 's Who Killed the Hero? light novel series.

Then, one night, as he's searching for his next bite of monster meat, a red-haired woman shouldering a greatsword appears before him and says to him, “You have promise. Become my apprentice.” How is he supposed to tell her that this must be some sort of mistake? But there's a secret that only she knows, and that he's stumbled upon: eating monsters makes you stronger! With her training and his newfound power, Mars will finally overcome all those pesky assassination attempts. However, that doesn't end things; no, it's only the beginning of a nationwide—even continent-spanning—series of wars and plots with him right in the middle!
Cross Infinite World released the sixth novel volume digitally on September 30.

Daken launched the original story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" website in January 2022, and the latest update was in January 2023. Micro Magazine 's GCN Bunko label started publishing the story in compiled volume format in September 2023 with illustrations by Shiba . The company will publish the seventh volume on October 20.

Karin Suzuragi ( Danganronpa 2: Chiaki Nanami's Goodbye Despair Quest , Isekai Cheat Magician ) launched a manga adaptation of the novel series in January 2024 in Hakusensha 's Young Animal Zero magazine. Hakusensha will publish the third compiled volume on October 29.

Daken 's Tsuihо̄ Sareta Shо̄nin wa Kin no Chikara de Sekai wo Sukū light novel series is also slated to get an upcoming television anime adaptation. Seven Seas Entertainment is releasing Daken 's The Suspects of Necromancy and The Wicked Princess and Her Twelve Eyes light novel series in English. Yen Press is releasing Daken 's Who Killed the Hero? light novel series.

title: Girls und Panzer Franchise Gets 2 New Games
content:
D3Publisher and G Holdings each announced a new game for the Girls und Panzer franchise on Friday. D3Publisher is developing the Girls und Panzer : All-Star Tank Carnival game, while G Holdings is developing the Girls und Panzer : Bokosuka Rush game. D3 Publisher is streaming the below trailer for Girls und Panzer : All-Star Tank Carnival .

Girls und Panzer : All-Star Tank Carnival will launch for the Switch 2 in Japan in 2027. The same team that handled the Girls und Panzer Dream Tank Match PlayStation 4 game is also working on the new game. The game will focus on controllable tank battles, but will also allow players to control Miho and walk around a recreation of the story's Ōarai town (itself based on the real-life town of Ōarai).

Girls und Panzer : Bokosuka Rush will be a smartphone game. G Holdings did not reveal a release date for the game. G Holdings describes the game as being set in the "Boko Museum" that appears in the Girls und Panzer der Film anime. In the game, Miho and Alice visit the museum and try out the "tank simulator" there, only to be confronted with Boko as their enemy. The game will allow players to mix up crew and the tanks they operate, with crew getting progressively better, and unlocking more abilities for tanks.

Girls und Panzer Dream Tank Match launched for the PS4 in Japan and Southeast Asia (with English text support) in February 2018. The Girls und Panzer Dream Tank Match DX Switch version shipped in Japan and Southeast Asia (with English text support) in February 2019.

title: Crunchyroll, HAYATE, LINE Digital Frontier Partner to Produce Anime of 'Around' 15 Webtoons
content:
Crunchyroll will exclusively stream the anime made through this partnership in select territories.

HAYATE Inc. was founded in March 2025 and is headquartered in Tokyo. Aniplex 's Masanori Miyake leads the venture as Chairman and CEO along with President and COO Leo Watanabe . The staff is composed of Aniplex and Crunchyroll employees. HAYATE is focusing specifically on planning, developing, and producing anime content for Crunchyroll 's streaming platform worldwide. In April, HAYATE acquired all shares of anime studio Lay-duce , making it a wholly owned subsidiary. HAYATE is overseeing the production of the upcoming Ghost of Tsushima: Legends ( Ghost of Tsushima: Kuroudo Kitan ) anime series.

LINE Digital Frontier CEO Shin-bae Kim had announced in February 2025 that the company would produce 20 animated adaptations of webtoons that year, significantly expanding its webtoon-based IP business. LINE Digital Frontier is the operator of LINE Manga , the Japanese subsidiary of Naver Webtoon.

LINE Manga has been aggressively pursuing webtoon adaptations since 2024. In 2024, it produced 12 adaptations, a significant increase from just one in 2022 and two in 2023.

title: Comisma Enters Agreement With Akili International to Produce Live-Action Film of Zukyun x Bakyun Manga
content:
Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga, and describes the story:

Dan and Lyla are two highly trained, elite assassins who work together on the most dangerous of missions. They've only ever interacted on the job, so when Dan suddenly confesses his love for Lyla, the two find themselves up against something they have zero training for: romance! With their lives and hearts on the line, can this killer couple continue breaking bones without breaking each other's hearts?

Yuzuriha launched the manga in Comisma's GANMA! manga platform in October 2023, and ended it in September 2025. Comisma published the manga's fifth compiled book volume digitally on January 1. Seven Seas Entertainment will release the first volume in September 2027.
